checks.description: Reviewed the HP3 friction/noise robustness report and claim-a9ac9685183a4e3fb89ceff5a9664e8b at source/base revision 5bb8eb955fa680ddc631b6fb10f988ec3efb497a. Read manifest.json and the empty candidate.diff. Independently verified all 32 selected asset SHA-256 values against the submission manifest; no code candidate or ambiguous target remains.

Traced worlds, noise seeds, native artifact, exact argv, effective 12-iteration override, policy freeze, and posthoc-control declaration. Verified embedded frozen-source hashes and their correspondence to v2 run invocations. Inspected retained nominal service snapshots: the later service adds zero-mu injection and terminal observation, while saved first-step controls show zero-mu injection preserves nominal native state. Generator byte-equivalence is producer-reported, not independently rerun.

Independently recalculated Euclidean anchor errors and anchor RMSE from saved rounded M669 commands and checked firmware readbacks. Final maxima are 3.840677, 3.873242 and 4.349453 mm; each accepted dataset has 140 points and spread-consensus completion. Recomputed nominal step ratio 0.9927558. Checked typed fit tails of 2693.971606 and 2628.268920 mm, their active underconstrained penalties, production-valid marking, and their separation from final accepted geometry. This is saved-data arithmetic, not an independent fit or simulation.

Checked failed-collection journals, absent fit/application records, native guide readbacks and matched-control inputs. Active development default/v1/v2 and eval0 default collected 0/20/20/40 points and produced no geometry. Recalculated final clean encoder ranges of 23.2397, 18.1311 and 15.2112 degrees, exceeding the 0.3-degree guard. Eval0 active and noise-only readback rows differ only in the nine guide mu fields; scene, sigma, seed, runner and service hashes match.

Inspected constructed-probe state restoration, both saved probe arms, terminal observations and native load/friction source excerpts. Verified all five mapped source-file hashes against the stated Git revision and probe-source hashes against both outputs. Recomputed saved extension, rest/storage and signed-power identities. At 8 seconds the active arm has 53.4944/53.3527 mm local slack, zero local force and +0.0507058 Nm spool load; the zero-mu arm has 0.005027/0.002210 mm slack. No physics was executed and no complete energy balance was inferred.

limitations: Evidence is simulation-only and consists of preserved producer runs. Independent work here checked provenance, source and saved-data arithmetic, without reproducing fits, collection or physics.

One nominal policy/default pair and one posthoc matched control do not estimate robustness or hardware failure rates. Held-out policy arms, eval1, broader friction/noise ranges and extra-data recovery remain untested; disturbance values are hypothetical.

The probe restores observed fields into a fresh scene while retaining hidden history. Terminal snapshots follow cleanup, and the power samples omit body work and losses. The observations support a local slack/load-coupling concern, not exact failure replay, a full causal diagnosis or a physical-model fix.
practical_value: Keep the negative policy result and the concrete native slack/load counterexample. They justify withholding bounded preload as a robustness improvement and focusing any later physics proposal on guide transport and spool load coupling.
reason: The fixed report's scoped claim is supported: bounded preload preserved below-5-mm final nominal accuracy but failed to recover development collection; the matched posthoc zero-guide/noise-only default accepted below 5 mm while its active-guide counterpart failed before fitting. Commands, native readbacks, policy hashes, fit histories and applied-geometry arithmetic agree. The report correctly distinguishes severe intermediate candidates from final consensus and limits its constructed-probe inference. Keep this report-only failure record. The empty production diff requires no code-delivery gates, and no additional numerical run is needed for this decision.
